title: Object Storage: outage review handling
content:
Object Storage outage review is handled on request. The accountant completes one storage outage assessment against the existing incident report. The assessment becomes approved and eligible with its nonnegative USD concession; the approved receipt confirms assessment completion.

## Invocation

assess_storage_outage_30bc4acc. This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameters

- storage_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the selected storage evidence or assessment copied from find_storage_events, find_storage_holdings, find_customers or the corresponding completed action receipt. This is the outage review input.
- source_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the original invoice or completed payment copied from find_storage_events, find_storage_holdings, find_customers or the corresponding completed action receipt. This is the outage review input.
- related_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the linked incident, assessment or concession copied from find_storage_events, find_storage_holdings, find_customers or the corresponding completed action receipt. This is the outage review input.
- storage_holding_id: Id class — Identifier of the storage contract copied from find_storage_events, find_storage_holdings, find_customers or the corresponding completed action receipt. This is the outage review input.
- request_id: Id class — Identifier of the customer claim or refund authorization copied from find_storage_events, find_storage_holdings, find_customers or the corresponding completed action receipt. This is the outage review input.
- credited_amount: Fixed-format class — Unit USD; format USD to two decimals. Nonnegative claim or authorization amount as a decimal number, rounded half-up before submission and stored to two decimal places; empty is not allowed. This is the outage review input.

## Successful return

For outage review, a string reading Recorded with the storage business record identifier and the USD amount; Recorded confirms that the stated action completed successfully.
